tech_depth.evidence: Screenshot 2 lists 7 automated checks mapped to specific files (scripts/validate.mjs, lib/guild.ts, validate.yml), with a serverless GitHub Actions design and a stated limitations section. The measured CI stats (34 PR checks, 1 rejection, median 29s) show measurement. Still no auth/payment/DB hard parts, and the 'why' is only partly explained.
tech_depth.fix: Add a short design-rationale section explaining why serverless/CI-only, with false-positive/negative rates of the link checker and AI score variance.

traction.evidence: Screenshot 1 badge: 'registered developers: 1'; the only profile is the author's own. The only numbers are internal CI runs (34), not users or usage. GitHub: 1 repo, 0 stars.
traction.fix: Onboard 5-10 real developers and publish verified counts (profiles, visits, PRs from others) with dates.

differentiation.evidence: Angle is distinct: every claim requires a public proof link, account-ownership matching, and CI-committed AI scores (screenshot 2). But no proprietary data, merged OSS contributions, or awards are visible.
differentiation.fix: Show a unique asset, e.g. a public dataset of verification results, or an interview-backed insight from recruiters on why this matters.

evidence.evidence: Two live GitHub Pages links, public repo, a 'view actual rejected run' and 'CI run log' link, and number-centric short sentences in screenshot 2. Bio paragraph is long, though.
evidence.fix: Trim the bio to 3 short lines with numbers and add a 30-second demo or GIF of a PR being rejected.

commercial.evidence: Targets listed in nav ('기업·투자자') but no pricing, revenue model, waitlist or customer is stated; both products have mrr_band 'none'. Open to cofounder only.
commercial.fix: State a specific buyer (e.g. seed-stage recruiters), a price point, and get at least one pilot or waitlist number.

design.evidence: Screenshots show a dark, consistent theme with a large headline '말보다 증거.', clear nav, and a stat-card + table layout on the verify page with clear hierarchy. Minor issues: large empty gap between headline and subtext, low-contrast small gray text.
design.fix: Tighten hero spacing and raise contrast of secondary text; place the sub-headline directly under the title.

innovation.evidence: Applies CI-enforced verification to resumes/portfolios (link liveness, PR author = profile owner, CI-committed AI score), a new method vs. self-written resumes, though proof-based portfolios and GitHub-based verification are not entirely new.
innovation.fix: Demonstrate what's novel with a side-by-side comparison against LinkedIn/GitHub profile, and show a case where verification caught a fake claim.

summary.en: A well-designed, transparent verification-first profile platform with concrete CI checks and real CI measurements (34 runs, 1 rejection, 29s median). However, it has one registered user, no external traction, no revenue, one repo with 0 stars, and no customer evidence.
summary.ko: CI 검증 구조가 구체적이고 실측치(34회 실행, 1회 거절, 중앙값 29초)까지 보여 주는 깔끔한 증거 중심 플랫폼입니다. 다만 등록 개발자는 1명이고 외부 사용자·매출이 없으며, 저장소 1개에 스타 0개입니다.
